description: This PHP source file defines the Goteo\Library\Newsletter class, which provides static methods for generating SQL queries related to newsletter testers, receivers, and donors, as well as methods for generating newsletter content with dynamic project and post data.

classes.name: Newsletter
classes.description: Provides static methods for generating newsletter-related SQL queries and content rendering.

methods.name: getTestersSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query string to retrieve testers based on language preferences.

methods.name: getTesters
methods.description: Retrieves a list of testers or the count of testers, with pagination support.

methods.name: getReceiversSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query string to retrieve active users eligible to receive newsletters, considering preferences.

methods.name: getReceivers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of newsletter receivers or the count, with pagination support.

methods.name: getDonorsSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query string to retrieve donors based on language preferences and investments within the current year.

methods.name: getDonors
methods.description: Retrieves a list of donors or the count, considering the current fiscal year and investments.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Generates newsletter content with dynamic inclusion of projects, posts, and other elements, supporting multiple languages.
